content: Hi, I need a mask, I can't be part of them without one.
I've heard you're a natural at making masks. Can you help me?
Could you help me look like I'm blooming
HIII, heard that you sell super cool masks, could i maybe have one too?
Aren't you the one that makes those colorful masks? Would you please make me one?
Could I... Could I please have a mask?
Need somethin'. Could ya help me get sorted?
Small one, need a mask from ya. Can ya do it?
Hey hey hey, friend! Need a new look. Mind helping me?
Good day! I intend to purchase one of your masks.
I would like to inquire about your availability. I would like to purchase a mask.
Nice shop you have here. Would it be possible, perchance, for you to help me?

repair_plant_1: Hey there, sorry to bother you but sadly it this mask can't grow itself back together.

repair_plant_2: Hello, I tried it with letting it stay in the sun, but I think you have to fix the mask for me.

repair_plant_3: It seems I forgot to take care of the mask like I do with my cacti, could you repair it?

repair_animal_1: Hewwo, I broke my super cool mask, totally by accident, could you repair it pretty pleaseee???

repair_animal_2: Pushed it down the table, now mask neeeds fixi pleaaassee?

repair_animal_3: A piece went missing when I wasn't looking, could you make it be on the mask again?

repair_shoe_1: Ey there, could you fix this up for me!

repair_shoe_2: Oy, mask maker, need fixing for this!

repair_shoe_3: Mask dude, this needs fix, go do that!

repair_lamp_1: I beg your pardon, it seems that my mask happens to be in an unacceptable condition, could you take a look at it?

repair_lamp_2: I am sorry to bother you, but I have the urgent repair for you to set this item into its former state.

repair_lamp_3: My asset is in dire need of an overhaul, please see to that.

win_plant: The plant cult grew so big that the world is overgrown. Everything is full of plants and you cant go anywhere anymore without a way through the undergrowth. On the good side tho, CO2 induced climate change is no more and wooden masks are cheaper to produce

win_animal: Animals are on the loose, nobody is distinguishing between 'people' and 'animals anymore. Your customer variety is growing immensively and you profit a lot

win_shoe: The shoe cult is at power, shoes are a must now. Walking barefoot is a crime, and masks are being replaced with shoes as hats. You kinda played yourself

win_lamp: The cult of the lamp managed to hide the light of sun, making it necessary to buy lamps from them. Masks containing a light source are especially profitable lately

win_all: IT IS CHAOS. The wolrd is burning and unlike anything you knew before. The different cults are fighting each other causing everything to collapse. Masks particulary are in hype it seems.
